title: Hosted API conformance harness, acceptance criteria, and launch checklist for generation+embeddings
creator: Priya Shah
description: This ticket delivers the Product Requirements Document (PRD) and an operational launch checklist for the hosted API bundle (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank). Scope is focused on behavioral conformance, observable acceptance gates, and automated harnesses that validate: output quality, backward compatible behavior, latency/cost SLOs, and safe degraded modes. Goal: provide a reproducible acceptance flow enabling PM/Eng/Design sign-off prior to GA launch.
scope: In-scope: definition of acceptance criteria, automated conformance harness (unit + integration tests + eval sets), rollout canary gates, observability hooks, smoke/chaos test plans, docs for customer-visible degradation modes. Out-of-scope: major API surface changes, new SDK features, pricing changes; these will be handled in follow-up tickets.
requirements: Define canonical prompt/test set for each surface: chat, completion, embedding, rerank (maintainable CSV in repo)
Build an automated harness that runs nightly conformance suite against canary/staging clusters and reports regressions to Slack and PR checks
Latency targets per route (P95) and cost-per-1k-token targets, with clear thresholds for blocking vs non-blocking rollouts
Failover and fallback behavior: explicit deterministic degradation path (model variant, regional fallback) documented and tested
Operational dashboarding: per-route P50/P95/P99, token-metered cost estimates, error breakdowns, and top failing prompts
Acceptance checklist items that can be verified by PM/Eng/Design without deep infra access
Security checklist: SSO/SAML flows exercised on staging, KMS access verified for private deployments
Release artifacts: PRD, test-run artifacts, signed acceptance doc, and rollout runbook
acceptance_criteria: Behavioral parity: No regression on the core prompt set: overall pass rate >= 97% on model-staging vs baseline (baseline = last GA candidate)
Quality thresholds: mean embedding cosine similarity to baseline >= 0.96 on benchmark set; rerank NDCG@10 delta <= 0.02
Latency SLOs: chat/completions P95 <= 280ms for typical (<=1k tokens) requests; embeddings P95 <= 220ms
Cost guardrail: observed cost per 1k tokens within 12% of expected projection during 2h steady-state soak test
Reliability SLO: 99.95% availability during load tests simulating expected traffic patterns (including burst) with no more than 5% fallback routing events
Observability: telemetry emitted for each request with route, model_version, quantization_profile, and cache_hit boolean; traces linkable to Grafana + tracing UI
Canary gate: automated canary pass (conformance harness green + latency/cost within thresholds) required before progressive rollout beyond 5% traffic
Chaos resilience: simulated KV cache eviction test shows <1% error rate and <2x latency increase for affected requests
Security: security review closed with findings remediated or accepted and documented
Docs: developer-facing docs and migration notes published and linked in release notes
rollout_checklist: Pre-merge: PRD reviewed and approved by PM/Design/Engineering
Pre-merge: automated harness integrated into CI with required checks
Pre-deploy: security review completed and sign-off recorded
Staging: run full conformance harness against staging model slice; attach artifacts to ticket
Canary 1 (5% traffic, region A): run 4-hour soak, monitor canary dashboard and conformance alerts
Canary 2 (25% traffic, multi-region): run 6-hour soak, run additional load test and chaos KV eviction
Progressive ramp to GA with metric gates enforced by orchestration (latency, error rate, conformance pass rate)
Fallback validation: trigger fallback policy in staging and verify degraded behavior docs
Customer communications: prepare status page message + known issue guide
GA: update developer docs, publish release notes, notify customers with early access
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: conformance harness flakiness -> Mitigation: isolate nondeterministic tests, add retries and snapshot-based assertions
Risk: cost spike during canary due to unexpected tokenization patterns -> Mitigation: token distribution analysis pre-rollout and temporary throttles
Risk: observability gaps -> Mitigation: mandatory instrumentation PR and smoke checks prior to canary
Risk: late API behavior edge-cases -> Mitigation: small closed beta and fast rollback playbook
